name: Focus Rail
hypothesis: A persistent list rail and one calm task queue help occasional users see the next useful action without losing private-list context.
optimize_for: comprehension, confidence, and low cognitive load
tradeoff: Less simultaneous status context and more navigation when comparing several lists.

axes.information_architecture: one selected list as a focused queue
axes.workflow_model: capture then triage then complete within one list
axes.navigation_model: persistent list rail with one active context
axes.content_hierarchy: next action first, details on demand
axes.interaction_model: inline capture with direct status menu
axes.visual_language: warm neutral surfaces with one focus accent
